$description: SIRAJ Motion System v1.0 — the six motion levels. Single source shared by the Design System (motion hooks) and the Motion System. Easings come from 09-Design-System tokens (flow, drape, glide, fold, reveal).

drape.use: DRAPE / SETTLE — arrives, then settles like fabric

reveal.use: REVEAL — masks and silk uncovering content

hero.use: hero reveals, silk sweeps, project reveals

cinematic.use: intro, outro, logo reveal, full-screen transitions

reducedMotion: Under prefers-reduced-motion every level becomes an opacity-only change of 120ms; no translate, scale, blur or camera.
note: v1.0 order is micro < fast < standard < emphasis < hero < cinematic. (09-Design-System v0 named 1200ms 'cinematic' and 2400ms 'hero'; those legacy CSS variables are kept for backward compatibility.)
